# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: Map task jvm never exits since netty 4 upgrade
- Jira bug report description: Some changes made to the NettyClient.stop() logic related to netty 4 are causing the final worker thread to hang up indefinitely, preventing the map task jvm from exiting. In particular, the call to ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture() is blocking inside the ChannelFutureListener callback and deadlocking. Simply moving the ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture() calls outside of the ChannelFutureListener callback and placing them at the end of the NettyClient.stop() method seems to cure the problem.
- Seed changes and their Git diff hunks: [{"fqn": "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.NettyClient.stop()", "git_diff_hunk": "@@ -545,0 +546,3 @@ public class NettyClient {\n+ if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {\n+ LOG.info(\"stop: Halting netty client\");\n+ }\n@@ -564 +567 @@ public class NettyClient {\n- \"NettyClient.bootstrap resources now.\");\n+ \"resources now.\");\n@@ -567 +569,0 @@ public class NettyClient {\n- ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture(executionGroup, context);\n@@ -570 +571,0 @@ public class NettyClient {\n- ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture(executionGroup, context);\n@@ -575,0 +577,7 @@ public class NettyClient {\n+ ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture(workerGroup, context);\n+ if (executionGroup != null) {\n+ ProgressableUtils.awaitTerminationFuture(executionGroup, context);\n+ }\n+ if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {\n+ LOG.info(\"stop: Netty client halted\");\n+ }"}]
- Initial static code change impact set: ["org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.ChannelRotater.channelList", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.ChannelRotater.closeChannels(io.netty.channel.ChannelFutureListener)", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.ChannelRotater.size()", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.NettyClient.addressChannelMap", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.NettyClient.executionGroup", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.NettyMasterClient.closeConnections()", "org.apache.giraph.comm.netty.NettyWorkerClient.closeConnections()"]

# Output Format
Return exactly one valid single-line JSON array of strings.
Each string must be the fully qualified name of an impacted code entity.
Do not include any additional text, formatting, or meta-information.
Do not include seed changes in the output.

Example output (four impacted code entities):
["com.example.Foo.someMethod(java.lang.String, int)", "com.example.bar.attribute1", "com.example.bar.Class.NestedClass", "com.example.bar.Class.Class()"]

Example output (two impacted code entities):
["com.example.package.ParentClass.ChildClass.field", "com.example.package.ParentClass.apply(long, com.example.package.ParentClass)"]

Example output (zero impacted code entities):
[]
